notes.en: In-app updates with explicit, immediate installation. Desktop notifications with Undo and per-screen remote pointer speed. Edge resistance releases after 100 ms of stillness. RTT P90 connection charts. Fixes for cross-device dragging, external displays, offline device status, audio recovery after packet loss, Windows administrator startup and idle CPU use. Manual update checks recover after failed downloads, and Oink reconnects faster after another computer restarts. Install 0.1.1 manually once if you use 0.1.0. The Windows MSI remains unsigned.
notes.zh-Hans: 新增应用内更新，点击安装后立即中断共享并重启。新增可撤销的桌面通知和按屏幕设置的远程指针速度。鼠标在边缘完全静止 100 毫秒后释放阻力。连接图表改为显示 RTT P90。修复跨设备拖放、外接屏幕、离线设备状态、丢包后的音频恢复、Windows 管理员启动和空闲 CPU 占用问题。修复手动检查更新被拒绝或在下载失败后卡住的问题，并加快另一台电脑重启后的重新连接。0.1.0 用户需手动安装一次 0.1.1。Windows MSI 仍未签名。
